title: Finite generic sheaves: reduction of second cohomology to constant sheaves
statement: Let $k$ be algebraically closed, $C/k$ a smooth integral affine connected curve, $K=k(C)$, and $\eta:\operatorname{Spec}K\to C$ its generic point. Assume (a) for every finite field extension $L/K$, its normalization $h:C_L\to C$ is finite, $C_L$ is smooth affine connected over $k$, and the canonical map $\operatorname{Spec}L\to C_L$ identifies $L$ with $k(C_L)$; and (b) for every smooth affine connected curve $D/k$ and every prime $\ell$, $H^2(D,\mathbf Z/\ell)=0$. If $M$ is a torsion abelian etale sheaf on $\operatorname{Spec}K$ whose stalk at $\operatorname{Spec}\overline K$ is finite, then $H^2(C,\eta_*M)=0$. The hypotheses (a) and (b) are inputs, so this lemma concerns only the finite-module trace and filtration argument.

source.place: Proof, paragraphs 1--3: finite primary reduction, trace retraction, normalization and filtration

proof.text: Use [lem-exc-abelian-sheaves-gmodules] to identify $M$ with its finite continuous Galois module and decompose it into its finitely many primary summands. For an $\ell$-primary summand, [lem-sc-sylow-module-filtration] supplies an open subgroup of index prime to $\ell$. By [lem-exc-etale-open-subgroup-fixed-field], it corresponds to a finite separable field extension. Finite etale restriction and trace have composite the degree by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-etale-trace-degree]. Multiplication by this degree is invertible on the primary summand; rescale the trace to exhibit a retraction.

Apply hypothesis (a) to this extension. The generic-point identification gives $\eta_*a_*M'=h_*b_*M'$, hence the original generic pushforward is a retract of this finite direct image. The sheaf $b_*M'$ is killed by the exponent of the finite group and is therefore torsion. Apply [lem-fd-finite-pushforward-cohomology] and exactness [lemma-weil-pbc-finite-direct-image-exact] to reduce to second cohomology of $b_*M'$ on the normalization.

At a short exact filtration step $0\to M_1\to M_2\to M_3\to0$, put $G_i=b_*M_i$ and $I=\operatorname{im}(G_2\to G_3)$. Left exactness gives $0\to G_1\to G_2\to I\to0$. The generic stalk comparison identifies $b^{-1}b_*M_i$ with $M_i$; exactness of inverse image shows that the torsion quotient $G_3/I$ has zero generic restriction. It is acyclic by [lem-sc-zero-generic-acyclic]. The two long exact sequences propagate vanishing from $G_1,G_3$ to $G_2$. Normality identifies $b_*\mathbf Z/\ell$ with the constant sheaf by [lem-fin-normal-generic-constant]; hypothesis (b) gives its second-cohomology vanishing. Induct through the finite filtration, then pass to the retract and sum the primary parts.

    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {C : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsConnectedCurve f] [Smooth f] [IsAffine C] [IsIntegral C]
    (hmodel : ∀ (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra C.functionField L]
      [FiniteDimensional C.functionField L],

        IsConnectedCurve (C.fromNormalizationIn L ≫ f) ∧
        Smooth (C.fromNormalizationIn L ≫ f) ∧
        ∃ e : Spec (.of L) ≅ Spec (C.normalizationIn L).functionField,
          e.hom ≫ (C.normalizationIn L).fromSpecFunctionField =
            (C.fromSpecOfAlgebraFunctionField L).toNormalization)
    (hconstant : ∀ {D : Scheme.{u}} (g : D ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsConnectedCurve g]
      [Smooth g] [IsAffine D] (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime],
      Subsingleton (Sheaf.H (D.constantZMod ℓ) 2))
    (M : Sheaf (Spec C.functionField).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hM : M.IsTorsion)
    (hfinite : Finite (((Scheme.pointSmallEtale
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap C.functionField (AlgebraicClosure C.functionField))))).sheafFiber
          (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj M)) :
